meaning: Independent source-derived evidence for named Interface pure value protocols, qualified identities, version eligibility and readonly structural signatures. No member implementation or transport.
values: Every declared public contract and each endpoint request/result has complete finite normalizer and key cases. Preserve exact UInt64 carriers, optional absence, nested public references, domain Value Object/Enum structural values, sum tags/payloads, list order and duplicate occurrences, canonical unique sets, frozen detached values and INTERFACE_VALUE rejection without getters or coercion. No factory witness or invariant execution.
identity: Public keys retain exact Interface selector and contract_id even for structurally equal shapes. Nested domain keys retain their metatype identities. Runtime TypeScript values remain structural, not nominal brands.
version: Interpret canonical three-component versions independently using exact integer tuple comparison. Backward requires same major and provider >= consumer; exact requires equality. Include 64-digit boundaries, adjacent tuples, zero-major, malformed and active non-string inputs. Version eligibility does not imply shape compatibility.
signatures: Independently derive normalized source types and compile an exact type-equality consumer against the emitted Interface/PublicContracts declarations. Check readonly fields and members, exact request/result shape, Promise result, no extra or omitted members, no any/unknown substitution. Signature controls never run members. Their source, configuration and native dependencies remain currentness-bound.
bindings: Inspect exact frozen public/endpoint protocol surfaces and inert descriptors independently reconstructed from source, graph, fields and contracts. Check version descriptor independently. No emitted descriptor or generator output supplies expected meaning.
effects: All source Interface leaf modules and ready native modules are audited separately. No runtime imports, class construction, dynamic imports, ambient effects, Object mutation APIs or direct prototype freezing. Type-only Promise syntax is permitted; runtime Promise is not. All source nodes retained at finite capacity; substituted audit observations, scripts, modules or late changes invalidate dependent evidence.
bounds: 4096 cases/fact expansions per node, depth 64 and 8 MiB serialized node; project 65536 cases and 8 MiB. Native output and descriptor visits 65536/depth64; AST 1000000 visits/depth512. Signature expansion limited to 8 MiB per node. Capacity retains the whole node as not_evaluable. Bounded differential and syntactic evidence, not universal purity or arbitrary Proxy/modified-intrinsic isolation.
compatibility: Preserve all 54 predecessor source bytes, schemas, generators, defaults and completed controls; preserve full R08-R18. No SFOL, AlchLang, dependency installation, production effects, admission or publication.
